# Medical Bill Reader

> A direct-to-consumer, AI-assisted document explainer for supported medical bills and insurance Explanations of Benefits (EOBs). It organizes legible, visible information into plain-language sections and questions to verify. It is not a certified audit or medical, legal, insurance, coding, or financial advice.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-02

## Main tool

- [Medical Bill Analyzer](https://medicalbillreader.com/): One free analysis per browser per UTC calendar month (subject to network abuse controls), a $4.99 single analysis, or a $49 monthly plan with up to 44 analyses per UTC calendar month.
- The tool may organize visible codes, charges, adjustments, plan payments, and patient-responsibility fields.
- It cannot determine fraud, upcoding, unbundling, medical necessity, coverage, legal compliance, or whether a charge is correct from a bill alone.

## Privacy and processing

- Remove unnecessary names, addresses, member IDs, account numbers, barcodes, and other identifiers before uploading.
- The application forwards the supported document to Anthropic only after an affirmative processing acknowledgement.
- Medical Bill Reader does not intentionally persist the bill or report in its own database or send upload, analysis, report, or payment events to advertising or analytics systems.
- Anthropic's published standard commercial API policy states that inputs and outputs are not used for model training by default and are automatically deleted within 30 days. Anthropic says policy-flagged inputs and outputs may be retained for up to two years and associated trust-and-safety classification scores for up to seven years; legal and other published exceptions may also apply. Medical Bill Reader does not claim zero-data-retention or HIPAA/BAA coverage.
- [Consumer Health Data Privacy Notice](https://medicalbillreader.com/consumer-health-data-privacy)
- [Privacy Policy](https://medicalbillreader.com/privacy)
- [Cookie Policy](https://medicalbillreader.com/cookies)

## Current advertising status

No advertising code currently loads on the site. Any future ads require account and consent readiness and are restricted to nonsensitive editorial or marketing pages, never the analyzer, upload, results, pricing, checkout, or privacy-request experience.
